title: Plan three independent utility implementations
approach: Inspect the three target modules and implement each utility in its own isolated change: text_tools.py for slugify, stats_tools.py for median, and date_tools.py for is_leap_year. Keep behavior aligned with the tests and existing style: slugify should normalize to lowercase ASCII letters/digits, collapse any non-alphanumeric run into a single hyphen, and trim hyphens from the ends; median should handle odd/even numeric inputs without mutating the caller’s sequence and raise ValueError on empty input; is_leap_year should use the Gregorian leap-year rule. Because the work is independent, split it into three parallel tasks with disjoint file ownership and no shared edits.
acceptance: All three modules have concrete implementations, the existing tests remain unchanged, and the full unittest discovery run passes without errors. Each function should satisfy its module’s current tests, including empty-input handling for median and edge-case formatting for slugify.

tasks.title: Implement slugify in text_tools.py
tasks.approach: Replace the placeholder in text_tools.py with a focused implementation that lowercases input, keeps ASCII letters/digits, converts any contiguous run of other characters into one hyphen, and strips leading/trailing hyphens from the final result.
tasks.acceptance: tests/test_text_tools.py passes, including the word, punctuation, empty-string, and repeated-separator cases.

tasks.title: Implement median in stats_tools.py
tasks.approach: Replace the placeholder in stats_tools.py with a median implementation that works for odd and even numeric sequences, returns the middle value(s) as appropriate, does not mutate the input sequence, and raises ValueError when given an empty sequence.
tasks.acceptance: tests/test_stats_tools.py passes for singleton, odd-length, even-length, and empty-input behavior, and the caller’s original data remains unchanged after calling median.

tasks.title: Implement is_leap_year in date_tools.py
tasks.approach: Replace the placeholder in date_tools.py with the Gregorian leap-year rule: divisible by 4 is leap except centuries, unless divisible by 400. Keep the implementation minimal and pure.
tasks.acceptance: tests/test_date_tools.py passes for representative leap and common years, including century and 400-year edge cases.
